limitations: Historical suite counts are the authored gate-artifact summary; no retained per-test XML is in this pre-run directory. No new build is claimed.
Benchmark percentiles are tool output, not independently recomputed from per-request latency samples. Database confirms 12003 stored GET clicks; per-run log counts are corroborative only.
The pre-run image inspect describes image metadata, not a retained container HostConfig inspection. Read-only root and host publishing need the final container inspection.

The pre-run wire JSON supports stats/counters; it does not retain full invalid-URL and forged-audit responses or container JSON log joins. Jar statuses corroborate 400/403 but cannot alone prove body hygiene. Final installed captures must supply that proof.
Metrics differ from the committed historical export: retain the original with a source-custody qualification, and verify the refreshed package against its own committed inputs.
